purpose: 采用用户两问检查器，对酒瓶、碗、番茄酱罐、灶台开火四个独立真实仿真状态验证目的达成→实际开爪→退离→原归位。不开子agent、不微调。

hypothesis: 明确目的与夹持独立判断，目的达成直接开爪，可消除旧视觉误判和开爪前停稳阻断；真正未达目的的番茄状态应拒绝收尾。
information_gain: 四项同版真实控制接管，非单纯保存画面检查；番茄原末态未入篮，提供不得误触发的独立样例，不捏造已达目的状态。
success_criteria: 正例视觉目的达成且actual_open>0，实测标准开口，movement>0，旧streaming home>0且ready；独立目标维持、无持物/手部接触、标准归位连续五个实际post样本成立，最终两问视觉也通过。负例目的未达必须零收尾，且不宣称整任务成功。
failure_criteria: 正例未触发或actual_open=0记触发失败；开爪后阻断记对应执行失败，不能替代归位结果。负例误触发记误报。分别报告目的/开爪/退离/归位/最终效果。
unknown_criteria: 模型未知、网络、来源不一致或缺同步反馈记unknown；保存原始输入与响应，不无限重试。

changed_factors.name: checker
changed_factors.before: long multi-attribute prompt and automatic relation review
changed_factors.after: two-question concise prompt; one call per check; no relation review; encoder only controls opening

changed_factors.name: release_gate
changed_factors.before: up to ten closed-finger waits and five quiet samples before any open
changed_factors.after: hold current arm and immediately issue standard-open; two measured-open/arm-position confirmations; no pre-open speed gate
changed_factors.reason: 已达目的后实际执行补齐收尾，不等待VLA自行结束

fixed_factors.fixtures: exact five old input fixtures, select wine/bowl/sauce/stove; same full state SHA
fixed_factors.homing: unchanged joint_home.py, original streaming loop/config/path screening
fixed_factors.retreat: unchanged geometry.py, RGBD path screening and action budgets
fixed_factors.model: qwen3-vl-plus temperature=0, actual photos and synchronous encoders; no oracle inputs

scope.stop_rule: 每个独立任务只运行一次，当前例未触发/失败立即停止本例，不继续任何依赖组合；其余独立任务可继续。零新VLA，历史动作恢复末态。不开新agent，不扩大任务、不训练、不自动开启UI。

execution.mode: single primary agent, per latest user instruction; no subagent
execution.actual_model_override: none; current session model, no invented high/low switching
